description.blurb: Dinkinesh is a main belt asteroid that was visited by the Lucy mission on November 1st, 2023.
description.more: Dinkinesh was discovered in 1999 and is 700 meters (2,300 feet) in diameter. Dinkinesh was Lucy's first and smallest flyby target, and the smallest main-belt asteroid ever visited by a spacecraft. Dinkinesh is the Ethiopian name for the Lucy fossil, for which the Lucy mission is named.
